name: Wooden barricade
notes: Nailed planks across a doorway (mw-e03.11). Slash weak (no resistance: axes and swords hack through), blunt and force resisted 30%, arrows mostly stick (70% of pierce resisted). Being wood it is flammable, so fire burns through it too (the fire rules, not this profile). Five 0.25 m plank chunks; splintering wood is about 75 dB at 1 m.
